hints.title: Partition Around Split Boundary
hints.text: For a split boundary index, select the n smallest elements from the left prefix and the n largest from the right suffix.

hints.title: Prefix Minimums via Max-Heap
hints.text: Maintain a max-heap of size n to track the running sum of the n smallest elements from left to right.

hints.title: Suffix Maximums via Min-Heap
hints.text: Maintain a min-heap of size n to track the running sum of the n largest elements from right to left.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N log N) dual heap prefix and suffix sweeps
complexity.space: O(N) prefix and suffix sum arrays
complexity.notes: Prefix min heap and suffix max heap combination.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all combinations of element removals takes exponential O(3N choose N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix/suffix priority queues compute optimal sums at every cut point in linearithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combine forward and backward heap passes to evaluate all split points in O(N log N).
